name: Timerres
description: Allows changing the timer resolution in GD.

resolution.name: Timer Resolution
resolution.description: Requested Windows timer resolution in milliseconds. Windows may use a different actual resolution depending on the system. Settings below 0.5 are rarely supported and may be ignored or changed by Windows, leaving the timer resolution unchanged.

testing.name: Testing
testing.description: Runs a timer test by performing 100 Sleep(1) calls and measuring their actual duration.
